name: a-clean-main-takes-the-checkout-notice-away
replace: if let words = CheckoutNotice.message(for: reading) { checkoutNotice = words }
breaks: the notice can appear and never leave, so a checkout put back on a clean main goes on being reported as off it for the rest of the session, naming a branch that was left an hour ago. Re-reading is worth nothing if only one direction of the answer is applied (#668)
